status: Parameterized transcriptions of executed command excerpts, not byte-identical shell files or newly executed commands.

substitutions.EXISTING_RAY_SITE_PACKAGES: pre-existing installed Ray runtime reused by the virtual environment

selection: Only datasource extraction, environment construction, database start/version check, direct/e2e execution, and independent witness. Other source snapshots, status probes, readiness loop, archival/cleanup operations, and unrelated tests omitted.
execution_context: Original shell files used set -euxo pipefail. Do not enable shell tracing when supplying private credentials. PostgreSQL was ready before fixture execution.

commands.commands:
cd "$REVIEW_SOURCE"
for revision in 8d53e59e3da91a39beb6b1b614265cf05d3d26a4 c4ace0b69f82f66772d05c286ed29a52b6f73dc3; do
    git show "$revision:python/ray/data/_internal/datasource/sql_datasource.py" > "$RUN_DIR/sources/$revision-sql_datasource.py"
done

python3 -m venv --without-pip "$RUN_DIR/venv"
printf '%s\n' "$EXISTING_RAY_SITE_PACKAGES" > "$RUN_DIR/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/reused-ray-runtime.pth"
UV_CACHE_DIR="$RUN_DIR/uv-cache" uv pip install --python "$PYTHON" psycopg2-binary

docker run --detach --rm --pull=never --name "$PG_CONTAINER" --cpus=1 --memory=512m --tmpfs /var/lib/postgresql/data:rw,size=256m -e "POSTGRES_USER=$REPRO_PG_USER" -e "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$REPRO_PG_PASSWORD" -e "POSTGRES_DB=$REPRO_PG_DATABASE" -p "$REPRO_PG_HOST::5432" sha256:fe0737ba566a2c5b2a28f34433c0a423261900ec17b9bf7ad115e1aae7e57f1b
docker port "$PG_CONTAINER" 5432/tcp > "$RUN_DIR/results/postgres-address.txt"
docker exec "$PG_CONTAINER" psql -U "$REPRO_PG_USER" -d "$REPRO_PG_DATABASE" -Atc 'SELECT version();'

cd "$RUN_DIR"
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export RAY_USAGE_STATS_ENABLED=0
export RAY_DEDUP_LOGS=0
timeout --signal=TERM 180 "$PYTHON" -B -u experiment_bc.py e2e
docker exec -i "$PG_CONTAINER" psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$REPRO_PG_USER" -d "$REPRO_PG_DATABASE" -f - < sources/postgres-witness.sql > results/postgres-witness-psql.txt
